Exinity is an energetic and diverse company with central offices in the UAE, Cyprus and the UK, plus a number of smaller hubs globally. We’re always looking for talented individuals to join us. ‘Freedom to Succeed’ is not just a promise we make to our clients and partners, but to our people too. We’ll help you develop a range of skills, take on early responsibility, and enjoy a rewarding and fulfilling career with a fast-growing, dynamic company

Job Description
The Senior Liquidity Sales will lead the growth of Exinity's institutional FX and CFD liquidity business. The role is responsible for defining and executing the sales strategy, building a high-performing institutional sales team, developing long-term client relationships and delivering sustainable revenue growth. The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with deep product knowledge, an established industry network and a disciplined approach to governance, compliance and risk.
•
Develop and execute a comprehensive institutional sales strategy to achieve revenue targets, expand market share and drive sustainable growth across FX and CFD liquidity solutions.
•
Identify and prioritise target markets, client segments and commercial opportunities using market trends, client intelligence and competitor insights.
•
Build, lead, mentor and manage a high-performing institutional sales team, setting clear objectives and providing regular coaching and performance feedback.
•
Establish and maintain senior relationships with institutional clients, understand their requirements and deliver tailored liquidity solutions.
•
Act as the senior commercial point of contact for key clients, supporting client satisfaction, retention and long-term account growth.
•
Develop new business opportunities and strategic partnerships across the institutional market.
•
Work closely with Trading, Risk, Product, Marketing, Operations and Customer Support to align sales activity with business objectives and ensure seamless client delivery.
•
Monitor market trends, competitor activity and regulatory developments, translating insights into clear commercial actions.
•
Prepare and present accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates and performance analysis to senior management.
•
Ensure all sales activity complies with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies and the Group risk appetite.
•
Proactively identify and manage commercial and counterparty risks associated with client relationships and transactions.
•
Be an exemplary corporate citizen, modelling Exinity's ethos and brand values at all times.

Qualifications
Essential:
•
3+ years of institutional sales experience within the FX and CFD industry, including experience in a senior sales leadership role.
•
Proven track record of achieving sales targets, building pipelines and delivering revenue growth.
•
In-depth knowledge of institutional FX and CFD products, liquidity, execution and market structure.
•
A strong and well-established network of contacts across the FX and CFD sector.
•
Demonstrable experience of building, leading and developing high-performing sales teams.
•
Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills.
•
Strong strategic and analytical capability, with the ability to turn market and performance data into commercial decisions.
•
High levels of integrity, professionalism and accountability.
•
Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic and international environment.

Desirable:
•
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics or a related field.
•
Postgraduate qualification or relevant professional certification, such as an MBA or CFA.
•
Experience working closely with Trading, Risk and Product teams in an electronic brokerage or liquidity-provider environment.

Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

Responsibilities
• Investigate and resolve security incidents escalated from Tier 1 analysts, and find the root cause together with them.

• Act as Incident responder during security incidents and emergencies: coordinate containment, remediation and post-incident review, and write the incident report with follow-up actions.

• Run threat modeling, threat intelligence and threat hunting to identify threat vectors and turn them into monitoring use cases.

• Plan and run red team exercises and adversary emulation (phishing, initial access, lateral movement, privilege escalation, cloud attack paths), and work with the SOC in purple team sessions to improve detection.

• Support vulnerability assessments and penetration tests, and work with engineering teams to fix findings.

• Operate security services such as WAF and handle security incidents in cloud infrastructure.

• Build AI agents and scripts that automate alert triage, enrichment and investigation.

• Create SOC reports, dashboards and metrics, and present them to senior management.

• Keep incident response, business recovery and contingency procedures up to date, and coordinate with IT teams on escalations, outages and follow-up.

Requirements
What we are looking for

• 5+ years in IT security and proven incident response experience in an enterprise SOC or incident response team, including leading the investigation of real incidents.

• Strong working knowledge of security tools: SIEM, EDR, antivirus, WAF, IDS/IPS, firewalls, DLP, NetFlow and packet analyzers.

• Solid understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching and packet analysis, plus DDoS techniques and mitigation.

• Strong understanding of cloud security, especially AWS (IAM, VPC, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub), and experience handling incidents in the cloud.

• Familiar with IAM, strong authentication, PKI, endpoint security and security policies based on industry standards.

• Scripting in Python or a similar language, plus experience building LLM agents or AI automation (tool calling, agent frameworks, MCP).

• Excellent written and spoken English; able to present analysis clearly to engineers and executives.

Nice to have

• Experience in the Web3 or crypto industry is strongly preferred: exchange or wallet security, private key and custody security, on-chain monitoring and crypto-specific threats such as phishing drainers and account takeover.

• Malware analysis or digital forensics experience.

• Certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GREM, OSCP, OSEP, CRTO or AWS Certified Security – Specialty.

• Experience with PCI DSS, ISO 27001 or SOC 2 in fintech, banking or payments.

• Experience assessing the security of AI and LLM systems.

Join the Coins Team Now!

Meaningful Collaborations - The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with other relevant teams to carry out implementations that will improve and create an impact on customer experience.

Scalable Growth - Be part of a fast-growing organization with the vision to expand its territories outside APAC which will provide opportunities for career advancement.

A Space For Bright Ideas - Let your bright ideas be converted into meaningful changes! Coins culture welcomes new ideas backed up by data to create an impact.

Company Description
We believe the power of risk-driven investing can help anyone achieve a better life. And we’re here to make this potential a reality for an emerging global generation.
We provide individuals in the world’s fast-developing economies with guidance, tools, and easy market access so they can trade and invest with confidence. We aim to make our clients their own wealth manager: empowered to create investment strategies and make investment decisions effortlessly, in their own time, on their own terms, in their own way.
Our story goes back to the first days of online Forex trading - a pioneer of the Metatrader platform, Alpari, expanded rapidly in the world’s emerging markets and was joined in 2011 by our sister brand, FXTM. Now, we are adding further brands to our portfolio. Together, both brands have built a leading global presence in online trading serving over two million clients in 150 countries from regulated centres across four continents.
Exinity is an energetic and diverse company with offices across Europe, Asia and Africa, and we’re always looking for talented individuals to join us. ‘Freedom to Succeed’ is not just a promise we make to our clients and partners, but to our people too. We’ll help you develop a range of skills, take on early responsibility, and enjoy a rewarding and fulfilling career with a fast-growing, dynamic company.

Job Description
We are looking for a highly experienced QA Automation Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our real-time trading systems in a global Forex/CFD environment.

You will work closely with developers, product teams, and dealing/risk departments to design robust automated testing frameworks for pricing, order execution, trading cores, market data feeds, risk engines, and integrations with external liquidity providers.
Responsibilities
Automated Testing
•
Design, implement, and maintain comprehensive automated test suites covering:
•
order execution flows
•
market data distribution
•
risk calculations
•
Build frameworks for deterministic simulation of trading scenarios and edge cases.
Performance & Stress Testing
•
Implement and manage stress, latency, throughput, and stability tests for:
•
trading cores
•
pricing engines
•
real-time message pipelines
•
Detect bottlenecks, resource leaks, deadlocks
Quality Engineering & Analysis
•
Analyze business requirements, trading/risk logic, and code to ensure full test coverage of critical flows.
•
Work with developers and quants to identify root causes, validate fixes, and improve system resilience.
•
Build tools to automate operational testing tasks and regression checks.
Automation Operations
•
Ensure reliability of tests in distributed environments with eventually consistent data.
•
Maintain and improve AI framework.

Qualifications
Essential
•
Extensive experience in test automation and software development (5+ years preferred).
•
Strong coding skills in Python.
•
Strong experience with AI tools and agentic approach.
•
Strong understanding of:
•
concurrent systems
•
distributed microservices
•
event-driven architectures
•
Experience testing systems that use:
•
API (REST, gRPC, GraphQL)
•
Message brokers (Kafka, NATS, Redis Streams)
•
Deep understanding of software testing principles:

functional testing, integration testing, regression testing, performance testing, non-functional requirements.
•
Strong troubleshooting skills (profiling, metrics, logs, distributed tracing).
•
Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.
Nice to Have
•
Understanding of the Forex trading domain, including:
•
order types
•
execution models (A-book/B-book)
•
market data (ticks, L2)
•
risk systems (margin, exposure)
•
Experience testing FIX protocol integrations.
•
Experience with:
•
Docker/Kubernetes
•
GitLab CI/CD
•
monitoring/observability (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry)

Job Description
We are seeking a highly organised, proactive and service-oriented People Operations & Office Administrator to provide dedicated on-the-ground support for our growing Armenia team. This is a genuine dual role, with responsibilities expected to be split 50/50 between People Operations and Office Administration. The balance may vary during busy periods according to business needs, but candidates must be motivated to contribute fully to both areas.

The role will coordinate the local employee lifecycle from pre-employment and onboarding through employment changes, benefits, payroll inputs and offboarding. It will also ensure the Armenia office is safe, functional, well organised and welcoming. The successful candidate will work within a hybrid operating model, bringing appropriate activities in-house while coordinating closely with the local outsourcing partner, authorities, legal advisers and specialist agencies where formal oversight or expertise is required.

Key Responsibilities:
People Operations
•
Onboarding, Induction & Documentation
•
Coordinate the end-to-end local onboarding process once a candidate is ready to join, in partnership with internal stakeholders and the local outsourcing partner.
•
Prepare offer and employment documentation using approved templates; coordinate review, approval, signature and secure filing.
•
Communicate with new joiners, gather required personal and employment documents, arrange office visits and ensure all pre-employment requirements are completed on time.
•
Coordinate document movement, courier services and signatures between the company, employees and the outsourcing partner.
•
Plan and deliver local induction activities, ensuring new joiners have the information, workplace access, equipment and support needed to start successfully.
•
Maintain clear onboarding trackers and proactively follow up on dependencies, risks or delays.
•
Employee Lifecycle Administration
•
Coordinate local documentation and approvals for probation completion, contract extensions, permanent employment conversions, role changes, salary changes and other employment amendments.
•
Maintain accurate and confidential employee files, records and supporting documentation in line with company standards and local requirements.
•
Provide friendly, timely first-line support to employees on routine People Operations questions, escalating complex or sensitive matters appropriately.
•
Support the implementation of global People policies and processes in Armenia and develop sufficient knowledge to provide backup support to the wider regional People Operations team when required.
•
Monitor requests received through agreed service channels, including JIRA or equivalent case-management tools, and ensure appropriate follow-through.
•
Benefits, Leave & Payroll Inputs
•
Administer local employee benefits, including medical insurance, and support employees with routine benefit queries and documentation.
•
Coordinate local leave administration, overtime and other employee entitlements, ensuring records and required documentation are complete and accurate.
•
Gather, validate and submit monthly payroll inputs and supporting information within agreed deadlines.
•
Prepare basic People Operations reports and trackers using Excel, highlighting missing information, exceptions and upcoming actions.
•
Coordinate required documentation and signatures with the outsourcing partner while maintaining internal ownership of follow-up and employee communication.
•
Immigration & Right-to-Work Coordination
•
Act as the local coordinator for routine immigration, residency and right-to-work queries relating to Armenia.
•
Understand the basic requirements for common scenarios, including local hires, foreign nationals already in Armenia, spouses, transfers and international relocations.
•
Research requirements through reliable official sources, contact relevant authorities where appropriate and provide clear process guidance to internal stakeholders.
•
Coordinate end-to-end cases with employees, the outsourcing partner, legal advisers and specialist agencies, using external support where formal expertise or representation is required.
•
Maintain trackers for cases, documents, renewals and deadlines, and escalate compliance risks promptly.
•
Continuously build internal knowledge so routine questions can be resolved quickly without unnecessary external back-and-forth.
•
HR Systems, Data & Reporting
•
Maintain accurate employee data and records in BambooHR and other approved People systems.
•
Use SmartRecruiters where required to support employee handover from recruitment into onboarding and maintain complete documentation.
•
Complete regular data-quality checks and ensure records are accurate, current, confidential and audit-ready.
•
Maintain process guides, document templates, trackers and standard operating procedures for Armenia People Operations.
•
Use Microsoft Excel to prepare routine reports, reconciliations and status updates.
•
Offboarding
•
Coordinate local offboarding activities, documentation, approvals, signatures and employee communication.
•
Work with relevant stakeholders to arrange return of equipment, removal of access, final payroll inputs and completion of required local formalities.
•
Ensure employee files and systems are updated accurately and all actions are completed within required timelines.
•
Coordinate with the outsourcing partner and specialist advisers where formal local processes or signatures are required.
Office Administration
•
Office Administration & Facilities
•
Act as the primary local contact for the landlord, building management, vendors, contractors and workplace service providers.
•
Ensure the office remains safe, functional, fully operational, appropriately stocked and maintained to a high standard.
•
Coordinate maintenance requests, repairs, cleaning, supplies, access and day-to-day workplace requirements.
•
Manage courier and postal services, including secure movement of employee and company documents.
•
Coordinate office-related purchase orders, invoices, expenses, service contracts and supporting records.
•
Maintain accurate office documentation, supplier information and service agreements.
•
Support health, safety and workplace compliance activities in coordination with relevant internal stakeholders and external advisers.
•
Employee Experience, Events & Office Projects
•
Provide a welcoming and professional first point of contact for employees, visitors and new joiners in the Armenia office.
•
Coordinate local employee events, team gatherings and office celebrations, including venues, suppliers, budgets, logistics and on-the-ground delivery.
•
Support workplace communications and practical employee-experience initiatives.
•
Provide hands-on administrative support for future office projects, including the potential search for and transition to a new Armenia office.

Qualifications
Essential:
•
Previous experience in HR administration, People Operations, HR coordination or a comparable employee lifecycle role, combined with office administration or workplace coordination exposure.
•
Practical experience supporting onboarding, employment documentation, employee records, benefits, leave, payroll inputs and/or offboarding.
•
Basic exposure to immigration, residency, right-to-work or employment compliance processes, with the resourcefulness to research requirements and coordinate with authorities or specialist providers.
•
Strong organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple cases, deadlines and stakeholders.
•
High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accurate, confidential and compliant record keeping.
•
Professional written and verbal communication skills in Armenian and English.
•
Good Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Outlook, Teams and Word.
•
A proactive, service-oriented approach, sound judgement and the willingness to take ownership of both People Operations and Office Administration responsibilities.
•
Ability and willingness to work from the Yerevan office on a regular basis.
Desirable:
•
Experience in an international, fast-growing or multi-location organisation.
•
Experience working with an outsourced employer, payroll provider, professional employer or local HR services partner.
•
Experience with BambooHR, SmartRecruiters, JIRA or comparable HR and case-management systems.
•
Knowledge of Armenian employment administration, local authorities and common immigration or right-to-work processes.
•
Experience coordinating vendors, invoices, facilities, events or office moves.
•
Experience preparing basic HR reports, payroll reconciliations or operational dashboards.
Personal Attributes
•
Balanced interest in both People Operations and Office Administration, without viewing either side as secondary.
•
Approachable, dependable and comfortable supporting employees with day-to-day questions.
•
Resourceful and confident finding accurate information, asking the right questions and following issues through to resolution.
•
Comfortable working in an evolving environment where processes are being brought in-house and responsibilities will mature over time.
•
Collaborative and able to work effectively with local colleagues, global People teams, vendors, advisers and outsourced partners.
•
Committed to continuous learning and capable of developing greater ownership with guidance.

Additional Information
Measures of Success
•
Timely, accurate and well-coordinated onboarding, employment changes and offboarding.
•
Complete, confidential and audit-ready employee records and HR system data.
•
Accurate monthly payroll inputs, benefit records and leave administration.
•
Reduced processing delays and unnecessary back-and-forth with external providers.
•
Reliable coordination of immigration and right-to-work cases, with risks and deadlines clearly tracked.
•
Responsive, professional employee support and positive new-joiner experience.
•
Well-organised, safe and effective office operations in Armenia.
•
Effective vendor, invoice, facilities and event coordination.
•
Demonstrated contribution to both halves of the role, flexing priorities according to business needs.

We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.
About the Role

The MLRO Office is looking for a Case Investigation Specialist to manage and action cases escalated for review, primarily those generated by monitoring alerts and other internal escalations. You will be responsible for reviewing escalations end to end, assessing the activity, conducting tracing and preliminary investigations, documenting findings and rationale, and preparing clear case summaries and recommendations for MLRO review. The role also involves liaising with stakeholders across the business to ensure consistent case handling. It suits someone who can operate with ownership, discretion, and strong attention to detail, and who is comfortable managing a varied caseload under pressure.

What You’ll Do

• Manage and review cases referred to the MLRO Office that are generated by transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, blockchain analytics, name screening, KYC/EDD triggers, and other compliance alerts.

• Perform investigations into escalated cases.

• Review alert rationale, customer profiles, transaction histories, and supporting documentation to determine next steps on cases.

• Assist with pre-SAR filing mitigating controls, SAR/STR preparation support, and client offboarding/exit processes where required.

• Document investigation findings, decisions, rationale, and mitigants clearly, and prepare case summaries and recommendations for MLRO review.

• Maintain clear case files, investigation notes, audit trails, and MI for MLRO review and regulatory reporting.

• Liaise with internal stakeholders (e.g., Legal, Financial Crime Compliance, KYC/EDD, Regulatory Affairs, and other compliance teams) to facilitate knowledge sharing and consistent case handling.

• Participate in internal and external training programs related to AML/CFT, sanctions, blockchain analytics, and other subjects relevant to day-to-day work requirements.

• Support general administration and related activities as required and in accordance with business requirements.

What We’re Looking For:

• A university degree is required, ideally in a discipline that develops strong analytical, research, and critical-thinking skills.

• Appropriate ACAMS certification.

• At least 3 - 4 years of directly related experience in financial crime case investigations and AML/CFT alert review role, with substantial knowledge of relevant AML/CFT rules and day-to-day compliance affairs.

• Good analytical skills, systematic approach, and logical thinking.

• Strong team player skills.

• Proactive, ambitious, and user-focused attitude.

• Strong sense of accountability and ownership over the alert-to-case investigation lifecycle and MLRO review process.

• Self-motivated, able to multitask and work effectively under pressure and stress.

• Detail-oriented with a strong controlled mindset and time management skills.

• Strong communication skills, including the ability to engage professionally with internal stakeholders.

Nice to Haves:

• Good knowledge of local laws, directives, regulations, and other standards applicable to subject persons in the UAE/VARA context, plus awareness of upcoming virtual currency regulation.

• Experience with case management systems, SAR/STR filing workflows, transaction monitoring systems, or regulatory request handling.

Why Binance

• Shape the future of finance

• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

• Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy

• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

• Competitive salary and company benefits

• Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

About the Role:

You will support a risk-based monitoring programme across in-scope processes and controls, working alongside the Enterprise-wide Risk Assessment team and Compliance business units to assess control criticality, determine monitoring frequency, and support delivery of the annual monitoring plan. You will also support periodic reviews to assess whether controls are operating as designed, and help document outcomes for feedback.

What You’ll Do:

• Run the monitoring plan — execute the risk-based monitoring plan across all in-scope processes and controls.

• QA the frontline work — test retail and corporate transaction monitoring alerts and KYC files.

• Test control effectiveness — assess whether controls are properly designed and operating effectively, including input into control criticality assessments and the monitoring frequency matrix.

• Document everything — record results, observations, findings and improvement areas accurately, and independently manage and resolve disputed QA findings.

• Report and track — prepare reports and MI, and track follow-up actions, remediation items and outstanding issues through to closure.

• Coordinate across teams — work with Transaction Monitoring, SAR Investigations and KYC teams (local and offshore), and keep process consistent across jurisdictions.

• Flag risk and upskill — identify unusual activity and AML flags, support risk assessments, periodic/trigger reviews and EDD, and take part in AML/CFT training.

What We’re Looking For:

Anti-Money Laundering Officer (AMLO) – MiCAR / Crypto

1. Purpose of the Role

The Anti-Money Laundering Officer ("AMLO") is the designated key function holder responsible for establishing, managing, and continuously improving all policies, systems, and processes to counter the risks of the Company's involvement in money laundering, terrorism financing, bribery, and corruption. The AMLO serves as the central point of contact — both internally and externally — for all matters related to AML/CFT compliance.

This role is established in accordance with the Austrian Financial Market Anti-Money Laundering Act (FM-GwG), MiCAR (Regulation (EU) 2023/1114), the Austrian MiCA-VVG, and the FMA's published governance requirements for obliged entities.

2. Key Responsibilities

2.1 AML/CFT Framework & Compliance

•

Design, implement, and maintain the AML/KYC/CFT compliance framework across all business functions

•

Develop and update AML/CFT policies, procedures, and internal controls

•

Ensure rigorous implementation of the framework across the Company, including outsourced functions

•

Monitor regulatory developments and ensure sustained compliance with Austrian and EU AML/CFT requirements

2.2 Risk Management

•

Conduct and maintain the Company's Money Laundering/Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment

•

Identify and assess ML/TF risks related to customers, geographies, products, services, and technologies

•

Implement enhanced due diligence measures for high-risk scenarios (PEPs, complex structures, high-risk jurisdictions)

•

Ensure that ML/TF risks are considered in the development of new products, the taking-on of new customers, and changes to the business profile

2.3 Monitoring & Detection

•

Oversee behavior and transaction monitoring systems

•

Supervise the implementation and effectiveness of automated monitoring tools and alert management

•

Ensure adequate processes for detecting unusual or suspicious activities

2.4 Reporting

•

Act as the primary liaison with the Austrian Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU, A-FIU at the Federal Ministry of the Interior)

•

File Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) as required — independent of management instruction when exercising this function

•

Report at least quarterly to the Board of Directors on relevant events, findings, and compliance status in a formal report

•

Escalate key/high-risk compliance issues within the governance structure

2.5 Sanctions Compliance

•

Oversee sanctions screening processes and systems

•

Ensure compliance with applicable EU and national sanctions regimes

•

Coordinate with the Sanctions Officer on matters of overlapping responsibility

2.6 Training & Awareness

•

Design, implement, and oversee AML/CFT training programs for all staff

•

Ensure staff in relevant functions receive adequate and regular training

•

Promote awareness of AML/CFT obligations and red flags across the organization

2.7 Outsourcing Oversight

•

Supervise and control all outsourced AML/CFT functions (incl. shared AML services at AT Holding level and third-party tools)

•

Ensure that outsourcing arrangements do not impair the Company's AML/CFT compliance

2.8 Second Line of Defense

•

Lead and supervise the second line of defense regarding AML/CTF, bribery, and corruption

•

Work in close cooperation with the Head of Compliance on compliance matters

•

Coordinate with the COO on client onboarding and KYC processes

Aspect

Detail

4. Qualifications & Requirements

4.1 Mandatory (per Austrian FM-GwG & FMA guidance)

•

Expert qualification in AML/CFT — demonstrated through relevant education, certifications (e.g., CAMS, ICA Diploma), and professional experience

•

Good personal reputation (Zuverlässigkeit) — proven integrity, no criminal record relevant to the function

Senior management-level positioning — sufficient seniority and authority within the organization

Adequate professional experience — minimum 5 years in AML/CFT compliance, preferably in financial services or crypto-asset industry

FMA-notifiable appointment — the FMA must be notified prior to appointment; the FMA may revoke the appointment if qualifications/reliability are not met

Deep knowledge of Austrian AML/CFT legislation (FM-GwG, BWG, WiEReG)

Understanding of EU regulatory framework (MiCAR, AMLD 4/5/6, Transfer of Funds Regulation)

Analytical and risk-based thinking

Experience with AML/CFT technology solutions (transaction monitoring, screening tools)

Experience with regulatory examinations and FMA interactions

Experience building AML programs from the ground up or during licensing processes

Sufficient powers and means to carry out their responsibilities

As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. Sitting at the intersection of payment operations, treasury, and bank/PSP relationship management, you partner closely with Compliance, Finance, Risk, and trading-platform teams to keep funds flowing reliably, cost-efficiently, and within regulatory requirements.
This role reports to the group Head of Payments & Treasury.

How You’ll Make an Impact
•
Payment Operations & PSP Portfolio:
•
Portfolio Ownership: Own the PSP and payment-method portfolio (cards, local bank rails, e-wallets, crypto) across the brokerage’s active markets, from onboarding and integration through performance monitoring and offboarding.
•
Payment Routing Optimization: Optimize payment routing in the orchestrator to lift approval rates, reduce decline and failure rates, and lower blended cost per transaction.
•
SLA & Performance Tracking: Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.
2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:
•
End-to-End Flow Oversight: Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
•
Payout Management: Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
•
Fund Segregation & Reporting: Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.
3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:
•
Multi-Currency Liquidity: Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
•
FX & Hedging Execution: Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
•
Cash Forecasting & Yield: Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.
4. Banking & Relationship Management:
•
Partner Management: Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
•
Cost Reduction: Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
•
Infrastructure Redundancy: Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.
5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:
•
Multi-Ledger Reconciliation: Own daily and periodic reconciliation across PSPs, banks, crypto wallets, and the ledger, resolving breaks and ensuring settlement accuracy.
•
Regulatory & Compliance Alignment: Partner with Compliance on KYC/AML, licensing, and regulatory requirements affecting payment flows and client funds.
•
Risk Mitigation: Identify and mitigate operational, settlement, counterparty, and fraud risk across the payment and treasury stack.

•
Expansion & Automation Initiatives: Lead payments and treasury projects, including new-market and new-method launches, orchestrator and system integrations, and process automation.

Executive Reporting: Build reporting and dashboards on approval rates, cost, settlement cycles, liquidity, and payout performance for leadership.
•
Cross-Functional Scaling: Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Risk to scale payment and treasury capability as the brokerage grows.

Build & Scale: Define and build out the FNmarkets payments and treasury operating model - people, processes, and systems - to support the brokerage’s growth across new markets and product lines.
•
Team Leadership: Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing payments & treasury wing for FNmarkets business line, setting clear priorities, fostering accountability, and building capability at every level.
•
Innovation & Knowledge Sharing: Champion continuous improvement by staying current on industry developments, introducing best practices, and ensuring knowledge flows across the team and key stakeholders.

What You Bring

Industry Experience: Minimum 5 years in payments, funds management, and treasury functions at an international brokerage (CFD/FX/securities); strong candidates from payments firms serving brokerage clients also considered.

High-Volume Payment Operations: Hands-on experience managing client deposit and withdrawal flows, PSP relationships, and payment routing in a high-volume, multi-currency environment.
•
Treasury & FX Mastery: Treasury experience across multi-currency liquidity and cash management, FX operations, and working-capital or settlement optimization.
•
Payment Ecosystem Knowledge: Strong grasp of digital payment methods and ecosystems—card networks, local/alternative payment rails, e-wallets, and crypto/stablecoin settlement.
•
Commercial Negotiation: Demonstrated bank and PSP negotiation experience, with a track record of reducing fees and improving settlement terms and approval performance.
•
Reconciliation & Breaks Resolution: Solid command of reconciliation and settlement across multiple payment partners and ledgers, including breaks investigation.
•
Compliance & Safeguarding: Working knowledge of KYC/AML, client-money safeguarding, and the compliance/licensing considerations affecting cross-border payment flows.
•
Data & Analytics: Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with transaction data, dashboards, and spreadsheets to drive decisions.

Education & Communication: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; paired with fluent written and spoken English for coordinating across international partners and internal stakeholders.

Preferred (Nice-to-Haves)

Business Risk Management (BRM) is Swissquote’s first-line control function, overseeing client onboarding, periodic reviews, and ongoing lifecycle controls. Job Description
As Associate Director for Quality Control & Remediations, you will lead the team responsible for final quality checks on account openings and periodic reviews across New Client Onboarding and Existing Clients, ensuring operational excellence and alignment with BRM standards and strategic priorities.
Key Responsibilities
• Direct the operational and people management aspects of the Quality Control (QC) & Remediations team, fostering a high-performance culture aligned to strategic objectives.
• Oversee the second and final quality check on account opening and periodic review cases prior to finalization, ensuring consistent and rigorous application of standards across both workstreams.
• Produce qualitative and quantitative reporting on return reasons and QC trends, providing senior management with clear visibility on where and why cases are being returned.
• Identify recurring gaps or patterns from QC results and highlight areas where further training is needed, working with the relevant teams to close them.
• Own ad-hoc remediation exercises arising from audits, compliance testing, or other triggered reviews throughout the client lifecycle, ensuring these are scoped, resourced, and completed to a defined standard and timeline.
• Act as a key point of contact in audits, including participation in preparing, reviewing and presenting business responses together with management.
• Participate in strategic discussions with onboarding, periodic review, and other relevant teams, contributing a QC perspective to transformation initiatives.
• Exercise independent judgment on complex or ambiguous QC findings, determining when to escalate appropriately while making well-reasoned, timely decisions within established guidelines and guiding your team through them.
• Lead process improvement initiatives aimed at reducing return rates, simplifying procedures, strengthening first-time-right outcomes across the client lifecycle.
• Serve as a trusted partner to Institutional Sales, Compliance, and Legal, ensuring sustainable business relationships while upholding the Bank's standards.
• Actively contribute to recruitment cycle and performance management to ensure a motivated, high-performing, and accountable team.
• Coach and mentor team members, supporting their skill development and career growth.

Qualifications
• Minimum 5–7 years’ track record in client onboarding, KYC/AML, or compliance operations within the financial services sector.
• Previous experience in a leadership or team-lead role is a strong advantage.
• Strong knowledge of Swiss regulatory requirements (FINMA, AMLA, CDB) and onboarding / periodic review due diligence standards.
• Experience with remediation exercises, including scoping and delivering ad-hoc reviews arising from audit or compliance testing findings.
• Ability to communicate operational priorities and constraints to technical teams in charge of tooling and systems build-out.
• Experience supporting or participating in audits, preparing business responses.
• Sound risk and quality judgment, with the ability to make independent, defensible decisions on complex cases.
• Ability to prioritize and deliver on multiple tasks in a deadline-driven, high-volume environment.
• Excellent interpersonal skills, results-oriented team player.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English and French, German being an advantage.

Automation/AI Framework Ownership & Leadership:

• Define and lead the QA AI roadmap, continuously improving automation processes and adopting new tools and methodologies that raise efficiency, accuracy and defect detection before release.

• Drive adoption of AI-assisted testing workflows, including automated test case generation, intelligent ticket triage, and LLM-powered test coverage analysis integrated into our SDLC.

• Experience with test management platforms, preferably QMetry for Jira, including test plan creation, cycle management, execution tracking, and defect traceability reporting.

About us

Bitget is the world's largest Universal Exchange (UEX), serving over 125 million users and offering access to over 2M crypto tokens, 100+ tokenized stocks, ETFs, commodities, FX, and precious metals such as gold. The ecosystem is committed to helping users trade smarter with its AI agent, which co-pilots trade execution.

Bitget is driving crypto adoption through strategic partnerships with LALIGA and MotoGP™. Aligned with its global impact strategy, Bitget has joined hands with UNICEF to support blockchain education for 1.1 million people by 2027. Bitget currently leads in the tokenized TradFi market, providing the industry's lowest fees and highest liquidity across 150 regions worldwide.

What you'll do

1. Maintain and reconcile core trading analytics frameworks across multiple asset classes (spot, perpetuals, futures, forex), ensuring consistency in data definitions, metric calculations, and reporting standards.

2. Lead technical analysis of trading parameters including funding rate mechanics, mark price methodology, ADL (Auto Deleveraging) trigger patterns, and unified margin model behavior.

3. Review comprehensive technical memos and analytical frameworks on trading operations, market microstructure, and liquidity dynamics; validate assumptions and methodologies.

4. Lead the adoption of new trading products and market structure changes; assess accounting and operational implications for user portfolios and risk calculations.

5. Act as the technical lead in responding to internal and external stakeholder inquiries regarding trading mechanics, fee structures, liquidation rules, and API rate limit impacts on business operations.

What you'll need

1. 5+ years of technical experience in trading analytics, quantitative analysis, or market operations with a verifiable track record of managing complex multi-asset trading data ecosystems.

2. Direct experience analyzing and optimizing trading mechanics across derivatives (perpetuals, futures) and spot markets; demonstrated ability to translate market microstructure into operational insights.

3. Expert-level knowledge of derivatives trading frameworks, particularly perpetual funding rates, mark price methodologies, unified margin models, and liquidation mechanics.

4. Significant tenure within a tier-1 crypto exchange, quantitative trading firm, market-making desk, or institutional trading operation; or equivalent experience at a traditional derivatives exchange or brokerage.

5. Proven experience as a key technical contributor to cross-functional trading operations projects, including liquidity provider optimization, risk analytics, or product mechanics analysis.

6. Advanced understanding of the technical and operational implications of on-chain trading mechanics, including gas fees, slippage dynamics, and blockchain-specific settlement considerations.

Why Bitget?

• Bitget is the world's leading web 3 platform for copy trading and one of the world's largest and most respected exchanges
• We are a global company with staff members from over 50 different countries and regions
• We are growing and looking for world-class ambitious talents to help us continue this journey
• We have a streamlined structure that empowers employees to work efficiently, delivering the best results in a short timeframe
• We offer competitive salaries and benefits
• Blockchain technology and digital assets have the potential to change finance in a way no other technology can - be part of it!

If you are ambitious and believe that digital assets could be the next financial and technological revolution, please apply!

For more information regarding candidates' personal data processing, please refer to Bitget Candidate Privacy Notice.

About us
Crypto.com is building the regulated home for prediction markets and derivatives in the United States. Through Crypto.com Derivatives North America and OG.com we operate a CFTC-designated contract market and a registered clearinghouse. OG.com Prediction Markets lists event contracts on sports, politics, economics, culture, and crypto, including single-event contracts and combos.
 
The problem you'll solve
It's Saturday night in the US. A partner broker messages: their customers' orders are stuck, and their support queue is filling up. You do not yet know if it is our gateway, their routing, the market data feed, or the settlement logic. People who can fix it are in the US, in Asia, or asleep. Today, whoever sees the message first owns it. That is the gap.
You are the single owner of every production incident that touches OG.com Prediction Markets, the exchange, the clearinghouse, or our partner brokers, from the first alert to the final review. You do not write the fix. You decide who does, within minutes. You keep every affected partner current. You make the risk call on what happens in the next 20 minutes, the next 3 hours, and on Monday morning. Root cause is identified in the first 30 minutes. An issue does not sit open for four hours.
A platform failure usually hits many partners at once, not one. You run that room.
You report to the SVP of Product. You do not have a team on day one. Within 6 to 12 months, a person who is good at this builds the rotation and owns the partner relationships that come with it.
What you decide: severity, who gets paged, the live timeline, every partner update while the incident is open, and the recommendation to pause, halt, cancel, or keep trading. The on-call approver approves a pause or halt. Exchange Operations owns the listing and the settlement call. Engineering owns the code.




What you'll actually do:
• Own the incident. You are first on the scene for your shift and the escalation point when it matters most, which is the weekend. You classify severity, open the bridge, and pull in Engineering, Exchange Operations, Technical Support, Clearing, and Compliance. One timeline. One owner. If a page goes unanswered, you escalate.

• Run the partner side. You are the named contact for partner brokers and FCMs while the incident is live. You get their engineers on the same bridge, split what is confirmed from what is still unknown, and update them on a fixed cadence. Partners should never learn about our incident from their own customers.

• Make the market call. You judge whether trading is still fair and orderly and recommend pause, halt, cancel, or continue. An exchange that is up while a front end is down, so some participants cannot cancel resting orders, is still an incident. Error-trade, settlement-correction, and emergency-action decisions follow the rulebook and are written down as they happen.

• Keep the regulatory clock. You know which incidents need prompt notice to the CFTC and you get Compliance the facts while the incident is still live. You track the rulebook timers: 30-minute notice on a busted trade, the 24-hour settlement-error window, and the 24-hour filing deadline for emergency rules.

• Investigate the incidents that are not outages. A listing that does not match the real event. A disputed result. A combo with a voided leg. A sports or event feed that is late, missing, or contradicts another source. You assemble the rules, the official outcome, and the evidence so Exchange Operations can call it correctly and on time.

• Close it and hand it over. The record stays current, including who approved each decision. Monday teams pick up open items from your handoff without calling you. You run a blameless review, write the root cause, and track every action, ours and the partner's, until it is closed. Partners get a written report their compliance teams can reuse.

• Get ahead of the peaks. Before the Super Bowl, March Madness, election night, and NFL Sunday, you run readiness reviews and joint drills with partner FCMs. You own the runbooks, the severity matrix, the escalation trees, and the fixes you send back to Engineering.

Requirements:
• You have been the incident commander. You have led major production incidents end to end, as incident commander, incident manager on call, or the person a command center calls when something is on fire, in trading, clearing, brokerage, payments, or another always-on business. You can walk us through one minute by minute: what you saw, who you pulled in, what you decided in the first 30 minutes, and what changed afterwards.

• You have run an incident across company lines. Part of the fix belonged to a partner, vendor, or counterparty you did not control, and you kept both sides moving. Several of them were affected at once.

• You make the call with incomplete information. You can show a time you chose the 20-minute action, the 3-hour action, and the Monday action, and you can say what you would do differently.

• You are technical enough to triage. You can read logs and dashboards, query with basic SQL, and send an API error to the right team the first time. You do not need to write production code.

• You write under pressure. You have a status update, a partner notice, or an incident report that is accurate, calm, and useful to someone who was not in the room.

• You are hands-on. This seat is not a manager who waits for a readout. You run the bridge.

Preferred:
• Exchange, clearinghouse, or FCM experience: production operations, market operations, a control desk, or client technical support at a CFTC- or SEC-regulated venue or broker.

• You have worked a CFTC system-safeguards notice, SEC Reg SCI, or a FINRA or NFA notification, and you know a severity call can start a reporting clock.

• Prediction markets, sportsbook, or event contracts, especially settlement disputes, combos or parlays, and peak sports windows. Useful. Not required.

• Sports data feeds such as Sportradar, Genius Sports, or Sportsdata.io, and what you do when they are late or disagree.

• You have built or rebuilt a severity model, an on-call program, or a post-incident review. PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Statuspage, Jira, ServiceNow, Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, or a shared partner channel.

Schedule:
• Weekends are when sports volume and incidents peak, so this role is anchored there. Weekday time off is part of the arrangement. There is no fixed 12-hour grid. Outside your core days you join the escalation rotation for major incidents. Other regions cover the US overnight. You hand over at the end of your shift and pick up at the start. Plan to be on for the Super Bowl and election nights.

• The person who does this well does not manage the job by the clock. When a partner is down on a Saturday, you own it until it is stable.

Why this role:
• Ownership. This role does not exist yet. You will define how a regulated prediction exchange and its broker partners handle incidents together.

• Stakes. When something breaks during a Saturday slate, customers at some of the largest brokers in the country feel it.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

This role sits within SOX Compliance and is the senior technical authority for IT controls in the SOX program. You will set the strategy for ITGCs, IT application controls, and the controls over private key management and digital asset custody. Internal Audit independently tests the controls you own.

You will own the ITGC SOX program, building the control framework, testing approach, and evidence standards from the ground up. This is a hands-on role with real program ownership at a crypto exchange. The technology stack spans blockchain-native infrastructure, digital asset custody systems, and on-chain and off-chain processing, and engineering changes at a pace most companies never see. The systems are complex, the deployments are frequent, and the controls are consequential.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

 - Strategy & program ownership
   
   - Own the enterprise IT SOX strategy and roadmap, covering ITGC, ITAC, and digital asset and key management controls across all in-scope entities and jurisdictions.
   
   - Define the scoping methodology and risk assessment for IT SOX, including in-scope applications, infrastructure, wallet and custody systems, and third-party and service-organization dependencies.
   
   - Set control design standards and own the control framework. Design controls that fit modern engineering practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, cloud) and don’t slow them down.
   
   - Set the standard for management testing and evidence. Direct co-sourced and matrixed resources, and review the quality of their work.
   
   - Use AI-enabled workflows, continuous controls monitoring, and data analytics to move IT SOX from periodic testing toward scalable, automated assurance.
   
   Private key management & digital asset controls
   
   - Own SOX control design and coverage for the full private key lifecycle: generation, storage, access, signing and approval workflows, rotation, backup and recovery, and retirement.
   
   - Assess controls over key custody architectures, such as HSMs, MPC, multi-signature, and hot/warm/cold wallet structures, including segregation of duties, quorum and approval controls, and privileged access.
   
   - Evaluate how key management and custody controls support the existence, completeness, and safeguarding of customer and corporate digital assets and their financial reporting implications.
   
   - Assess controls over on-chain and off-chain transaction processing, reconciliation of wallets to ledgers, and reliance on blockchain data and third-party custodians or service organizations.
   
   - Be the SOX authority on emerging digital asset risks and decide how the control framework should respond as products, chains, and custody models evolve.
   
   Deficiency evaluation & remediation
   
   - Lead evaluation of control deficiencies, including root cause analysis and severity and pervasiveness assessments, and recommend classification (control deficiency, significant deficiency, or material weakness).
   
   - Own remediation strategy for open ITGC and key management findings. Drive executive-level accountability with Engineering, Security, and Infrastructure leaders.
   
   - Escalate gaps and delays directly to senior leadership. Report status to the Audit Committee as required.
   
   - Coordinate with Internal Audit so remediated controls are ready for independent validation.
   
   Executive & external stakeholder engagement
   
   - Be the senior SOX voice to the CFO, CISO, CTO, Controller, and the Audit Committee on IT control posture, risks, and remediation.
   
   - Lead the external auditor relationship on IT matters: audit strategy, reliance and scoping decisions, walkthroughs, and resolution of disagreements.

Escalate urgent or material matters promptly rather than waiting for scheduled reporting.

As an AI Security Engineer, you will help build the security foundation that allows Exness to use LLMs, MCP integrations and autonomous agents safely at scale. You will focus on making sure AI systems can access data, tools and critical services without creating risks.

A big part of the role is turning security policies and threat models into real, testable technical controls. You will work on the centralized AI gateway, build guardrails and policy enforcement for LLM and agent workloads, secure MCP integrations and tool access, design sandboxing and isolation controls for agent execution, create a human-in-the-loop service approach with risk scoring for critical actions, set up Shadow AI detection and use AI to automate security processes. You will also audit and harden the systems that make up the AI platform, from the gateway to on-prem model serving.

We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer who is comfortable working across software development, infrastructure security, identity and LLM engineering, including fine-tuning and serving models. You should be able to take a security problem, design a practical solution, ship it to production and measure whether the control actually works.

The goal is to ensure that every AI interaction, whether started by an employee, a service or an autonomous agent, goes through controls that are enforced outside the model, observable, measurable and independently verifiable, without slowing down adoption

• Enable AI agents to do real work without exceeding the access of the users they act for. Design and implement the approach where agents run in isolation, with no more access than their user, and a human-in-the-loop service approach that sends critical actions for human approval based on risk scoring.

• Find AI use outside approved channels and bring it under control. This includes setting up the process and tooling to detect cases such as personal AI accounts, unregistered MCP servers and working with SOC and IT to block, replace, or onboard each one.

• Scale AI security works with AI itself, so that reviews and monitoring keep pace with adoption. This includes automating security review triage, assessments of MCP servers and AI tools, and analysis of AI security events on top of LLMs, agents, and fine-tuned on-prem models.

Who we’re looking for

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Security, Applied Mathematics / Machine Learning or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Certifications are not mandatory. Relevant examples: CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), OSCP / OSWE, cloud security certifications. Courses or certifications in ML/LLM engineering or AI security are a plus.

• 5+ years in security engineering, platform / infrastructure engineering or backend development with a strong security focus.

• 2+ years of hands-on work with LLM / GenAI systems in production: building LLM-based services or agents, serving or fine-tuning models, or securing AI platforms.

• A track record of designing, shipping and operating production services and security tooling, not only reviews and audits.

• Experience in fintech, trading or other regulated, high-load environments is an advantage.

• LLM engineering and automation: solid practical understanding of how LLMs work and fail (context, sampling, tool calling, structured outputs, embeddings and RAG, agent loops, non-determinism); proven experience building LLM-powered automations or agents used in production, including evaluation (test sets, metrics, calibrated LLM-as-judge) and cost / latency control.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.




THE TEAM

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

 

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

 

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

 

 - Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.

 - Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.

 - Help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing managers sharpen their own briefs, bringing the concept, the hook and the cultural angle to the start of the process.

 - Pitch original concepts for paid and social before anyone asks, so ideas reach the team already sharp.

 - Make your own content for paid and organic. The format is open: you could be a meme machine, an AI video specialist, someone who performs to camera, or something we haven’t thought of. What matters is that it feels native to the feed and ships fast.

 - Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.

 - React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.

 - Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.

 - Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

 - A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Include one idea you spotted in culture or data and took to market, with a short note on what the results told you and what you changed.

 - A proactive, self-starting way of working. You find the idea, pitch it and drive it to be shipped without waiting to be asked, and you’re comfortable owning your workflow with light direction.

 - Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.

 - A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.

 - A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.

 - Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

 - Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.

 - A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

 - Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

 - Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

OneRoyal offers online CFD trading across a diverse range of asset classes. We are seeking an experienced and proactive Head of Compliance & AML Compliance Officer (AMLCO) to oversee the company’s regulatory compliance framework and Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing (AML/CFT) obligations. The successful candidate will act as the company’s designated Head of Compliance and AMLCO in accordance with applicable CySEC requirements, ensuring that the company maintains effective internal controls, meets its regulatory obligations, and operates in line with the relevant legal and regulatory framework.

This role requires strong knowledge of the Forex/CFD industry, experience dealing with regulatory authorities, and the ability to work closely with the Board of Directors, Senior Management, and operational teams to promote a strong compliance culture.

Responsibilities

• Oversee the company’s compliance framework to ensure adherence to applicable CySEC requirements, EU regulations, and relevant local and international legislation

• Act as a key point of contact with CySEC, MOKAS, and other relevant regulatory authorities, supporting regulatory communications, inspections, and information requests

• Develop, implement, maintain, and periodically review the company’s Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing framework in line with applicable requirements

• Conduct and oversee regular AML/CFT business risk assessments, identifying key risks and ensuring appropriate mitigation measures are implemented

• Oversee the effectiveness of customer onboarding controls, including CDD, EDD, beneficial ownership verification, PEP screening, and sanctions screening

• Oversee AML-related transaction monitoring arrangements, ensuring suspicious patterns, unusual transactions, and potential financial crime indicators are identified and appropriately escalated

• Assess escalated cases and ensure suspicious activity reports and other required notifications are submitted to the relevant authorities in accordance with applicable legal obligations

• Develop and execute a risk-based compliance monitoring plan to assess the effectiveness of internal controls, identify deficiencies, and follow up on corrective actions

• Draft, implement, and periodically update compliance and AML/CFT policies, procedures, internal guidelines, and control documentation

• Provide compliance guidance on Forex and CFD activities, including client classification, trading-related risks, transaction flows, and potential market abuse or financial crime indicators

• Advise client onboarding, payments, customer support, and transaction monitoring teams on compliance requirements, risk indicators, and escalation procedures

• Monitor changes in applicable laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, and industry practices, assessing their impact on the company and coordinating the implementation of necessary changes

• Organize and deliver regular compliance and AML/CFT training to employees, ensuring staff understand their responsibilities and reporting obligations

• Prepare periodic compliance and AML/CFT reports for senior management and the Board, highlighting key risks, monitoring results, significant cases, regulatory developments, and recommended actions

• Promote a strong compliance culture across the organisation, advise management on regulatory risks, support internal and external audits, and identify opportunities to strengthen the company’s compliance framework

Requirements

Job Profile: HR Business Partner

Position overview

Job title: HR Business Partner (HRBP)

Department: People

Business unit supported: Revenue

Reports to: CHRO

Direct reports: None

Key stakeholders: Revenue leadership and managers; People Partners team; Administration; Finance; Legal; Talent Acquisition; external EOR, relocation and immigration providers.

Company context
This role combines business partnering for the Revenue unit with hands-on ownership of HR operations: documentation, employment through EOR, and visa and relocation support. It suits someone who can advise leaders strategically and also get the paperwork right.

Key responsibilities

Business partnering

• Act as the main HR point of contact for managers, and translate business goals into people priorities.

• Advise on team structure, workforce planning and headcount in line with the business targets.

• Support performance management, goal setting and feedback cycles, and coach managers on people decisions.

• Partner with Finance and department leadership on the people side of compensation and bonus plans.

• Collect and analyse people data (turnover, engagement, performance) and turn it into recommendations.

Employee relations and communication

• Handle incident management: address negative situations, escalate relevant information, and follow cases through to resolution.

• Mediate conflicts and help build constructive communication between employees and teams.

• Take part in offboarding: run exit interviews and share turnover insights with stakeholders.

• Manage internal transfers and promotions, including moves into management roles.

HR processes and change

• Design, implement and maintain HR processes, adapting them as the company becomes more structured.

• Support change management during reorganisations and process changes.

• Lead HR projects and ad-hoc requests, and run research and consultations when needed.

HR operations and documentation

• Maintain employee documentation and records: contracts, amendments, policies and HRIS data.

• Manage employment of team members hired through Employer of Record (EOR) providers, covering onboarding, contract changes, offboarding and vendor coordination.

• Coordinate visa, work permit and relocation support: prepare documents, work with immigration providers, and track deadlines and renewals.

• Ensure HR practices comply with local labour laws in all countries where we employ people, working with Legal.

• Prepare HR letters and certificates, such as employment confirmations and reference letters.

• 3+ years of hands-on HR experience, including at least 1 year as an HRBP or People Partner.

• Experience supporting sales or other commercial teams is a strong plus.

• Practical experience with EOR providers, visa or work permit processes, and HR documentation.

• Experience in a fast-growing international company.

• English С1; Russian is a plus.

• Confident user of an HRIS (e.g. HiBob) and Google Workspace/MS Office.

• Full HR lifecycle knowledge and the ability to apply it in practice.

• Understanding of commercial team dynamics: sales metrics, incentive plans, quota-driven performance.

• Working knowledge of labour law and employment compliance across several jurisdictions.

• EOR models, immigration and relocation processes.

• Project management and change management.

• Facilitation, moderation and group work.

• Basic HR analytics: collecting, analysing and presenting people data.

• Coaching and mentoring managers.

• Basic understanding of the company's product and tech stack.

Soft skills

• Business acumen and credibility with senior commercial leaders.

• Attention to detail and accuracy with documents and deadlines.

• Resilience and composure in a high-pace environment.

• Ability to handle strategic and operational work at the same time.

About the role
We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Head of Architecture Office to lead our enterprise and solution architecture strategy, ensuring the design and delivery of scalable, secure, and high-performing technology solutions that support business growth and innovation.
This role will oversee architecture governance, technical standards, solution design, and system modernisation initiatives, ensuring consistency, efficiency, and alignment across technology platforms and engineering teams.
As a key technical leader, you will establish architecture best practices, drive technical excellence, and provide strategic direction on complex technology initiatives while fostering collaboration across Engineering, Infrastructure, and Cyber Security teams.
The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with strong strategic thinking and leadership capabilities, with the ability to remain hands-on, guide critical architecture decisions, and balance long-term technology vision with practical delivery, operational efficiency, and business priorities.

Responsibility
Enterprise and solution architecture
• Own and maintain the Enterprise Architecture: current state, target state and roadmap, including domain boundaries, integration and API patterns, data flows, resilience and availability targets, and cloud architecture on the AWS multi-account landing zone.
• Lead solution architecture for priority programmes, for example the client platform rebuild, identity and authentication services, copy trading, CRM and back-office modernisation, and platform migrations, producing Architecture Proposals and Architecture Design Documents with clear options, trade-offs and recommendations.
• Run the architecture review process: review and approve Architecture Design Documents from engineering teams, maintain Architecture Decision Records, and ensure decisions are communicated and adopted.
• Confirm technical feasibility of Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) together with Product Engineering and Cyber Security before delivery commitments are made.
Standards, technical acceptance and governance
• Define, publish and maintain architecture standards, development and coding standards, API and integration standards, non-functional requirements and technical acceptance criteria.
• Maintain a single documentation catalogue with owners, entry points and last-updated dates; standards and acceptance evidence must be viewable, not verbal.
• Act as technical acceptance gate for major deliverables and sit on key technology and business governance committees.
• Embed security-by-design and regulatory awareness into architecture: joint design reviews with Cyber Security (threat modelling, authentication and authorisation patterns, data protection, segregation between regulated entities), and support for the Security Exemption process where deviations are proposed.
Refactoring, technical debt and incident architecture
• Own the portfolio of product and system refactoring and migration initiatives: scope, phasing, expected benefits (stability, performance, maintainability, scalability, delivery efficiency), technical risks, legacy constraints and dependencies, with progress and phase outcomes reported against ETA.
• Lead root-cause analysis for major technical and architecture issues and high-risk production incidents, and define both the short-term fix and the long-term architecture solution, with owner, ETA and residual risk.
• Drive cross-team alignment on technical direction so that Product, Engineering, Data and Platform teams build towards the same target architecture.

We are hiring a Trader Support Specialist to be the first point of contact for our traders, resolving their questions quickly and accurately through Intercom.  - Clear, concise and empathetic written communication, with strong attention to detail.

 - Sound judgment on when to resolve a case and when to escalate it.

 - Ability to stay composed and responsive in fast-moving, high-volume situations.

 - Comfort working across time zones and flexible hours, as markets run around the clock.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Additional languages.
