The future of Web3 starts with you: Join us as an Quantitative Researcher.

Requirements

Education & Experience:

— MSc or PhD in a quantitative field; a live trading track record outweighs credentials

— 5+ years in quantitative research or trading at a top-tier HFT firm, market maker, systematic fund, or crypto-native market maker; exchange-side market-structure experience is a plus

— Hands-on experience with at least one TradFi asset class (FX, futures, equities) and / or equivalent crypto asset classes; both maker and taker strategies

Core Technical Skills:

— Advanced probability, statistics, time-series analysis, optimization; strict validation discipline (multiple testing, out-of-sample hygiene, live–sim parity)

— Market microstructure: order-book dynamics, queue position, fill probability, adverse selection and markouts, market impact

— Expert Python (NumPy, pandas/Polars, PyTorch); working C++ or Rust for latency-critical components

— Tick-data engineering at scale: columnar stores, cross-venue normalization, data-quality control

Market Knowledge:

— Crypto microstructure: CEX matching engines and fee schedules, perpetuals (funding, mark price, liquidation/ADL), cross-venue arbitrage, DEX/AMM basics

— TradFi microstructure: FX ECN mechanics (firm vs last-look liquidity, prime brokerage), listed futures; low-latency architecture (tick-to-trade path, colocation, exchange protocols)

— Inventory and hedging: quoting models of the Avellaneda–Stoikov class and extensions, multi-asset inventory optimization, hedging, settlement workflows, real-time risk limits and kill switches

Exchange Microstructure & Mechanism Design:

— Maker-taker economics and market-quality measurement: fee-tier and rebate architecture, per-segment elasticity, spread/depth/slippage/markout metrics, defenses against rebate farming and wash trading

— Liquidity program design: obligation-based schemes (two-sided quoting, presence at touch, minimum depth, uptime) and incentive-based schemes (tiered rebates, credit lines, connectivity benefits)

— Maker protection and flow segmentation: markout-based counterparty scoring, retail price improvement (RPI) order types, asymmetric speed bumps and latency floors, minimum quote life, self-match prevention

— Exchange P&L modeling: net fee capture, subsidy budget and payback, LP unit economics from onboarding to self-sufficiency

Mindset & Soft Skills:

— Owner mentality with direct P&L accountability; ships to production and makes honest kill decisions

— Clear written communication with traders, engineers, exchange management, and external LPs

— Compliance discipline across crypto and TradFi market-abuse regimes.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities — Liquidity Program:

— Design the program end-to-end: MM tiers, admission criteria, obligations (max spread, min depth, uptime, presence at touch), incentives, and graduation to subsidy-free self-sufficiency

— Optimize the fee schedule for net capture: taker tiers priced to measured elasticity by segment; maker rebates funded from taker fees; safeguards against tier gaming

— Design order-book mechanics for comfortable quoting: tick and lot sizing, post-only / iceberg / RPI order types, self-match prevention, minimum quote life, passive-liquidity protection options

— Build the toxic-flow framework: markout-based flow classification, counterparty scoring, continuous monitoring, access rules or surcharges for consistently toxic takers

— Own the program financial model and roadmap: subsidy budget with payback targets; phases bootstrap → organic profitability → self-sufficiency; a market-quality dashboard as the single source of truth

Responsibilities — Trading Desc:

— Own the strategy roadmap — crypto first, then TradFi FX and futures; design pricing, quoting, hedging, and execution as one portfolio

— Run end-to-end alpha research on tick/order-book, cross-venue, funding/basis, and on-chain data

— Design the inventory-aware hedging framework, portfolio risk limits, and parameter governance

— Partner with engineering on low-latency implementation; validate in high-fidelity simulation and canary deployments

— Own P&L attribution, TCA/markout analysis, and research standards

— Lead the TradFi FX entry research workstream (LSEG FX Spot Matching, Euronext FX).

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

Crypto financial markets generate enormous arbitrage opportunities, signals, and price dislocations every day — but most users lack the expertise to act on them. The AI Strategy Engineer we're looking for is someone who can transform these opportunities into executable AI-powered applications: one-click arbitrage, automated yield optimization, AI trading signals — giving ordinary users access to strategy capabilities that were previously reserved for institutional players.

You will lead strategy research, design, and deployment — developing deep expertise in funding rate arbitrage, basis trading, stablecoin yield strategies, cross-exchange arbitrage, and more. You will combine quantitative strategy logic with AI Agent execution frameworks to build automated systems that directly drive user retention and asset growth. This isn't a pure quant role, nor a pure engineering role — you need to understand markets, understand strategies, and know how to turn them into products users can actually use.

Key Responsibilities

•

Quantitative Strategy Research & Design: Research executable arbitrage opportunities in crypto markets including funding rate arbitrage, basis trading (perpetuals vs. delivery), stablecoin yield strategies (stablecoin lending loops, Launchpool hedging), and cross-exchange arbitrage. Complete strategy logic design, historical backtesting, and risk-adjusted return validation.

•

AI Strategy Application Development: Package quantitative strategies into user-facing AI applications. Design execution workflows, trigger conditions, position management, and risk controls for scenarios such as one-click arbitrage, automated yield optimization, and promotional opportunity capturing. Integrate AI Agent capabilities to enable automated strategy analysis, decision-making, and execution.

•

Market Signal & Intelligence System: Build a multi-source market intelligence capability integrating exchange market data, on-chain data, and community sentiment signals. Use AI models to identify hot opportunities, entry timing, and take-profit/stop-loss strategies, providing users with disciplined, AI-assisted trading signals.

•

Strategy Risk Control & Position Management: Design risk frameworks for each strategy class, including maximum drawdown controls, dynamic position calibration, and circuit breakers for extreme market conditions. Regularly analyze live strategy performance, identify degradation factors, and drive iterative optimization.

•

Strategy Productization for User Scenarios: Develop a deep understanding of different user personas (conservative yield-seekers vs. active traders) and translate strategy capabilities into perceivable product value — defining the core interaction logic, return visualization, and risk communication for strategy applications.

•

Cross-System Strategy Integration: Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate strategies with exchange APIs (including third-party exchanges), and drive the engineering delivery of automated strategy execution with unified cross-exchange asset management.

Requirements

•

Quantitative Strategy Experience: 3+ years of quantitative strategy research or trading experience, with at least one strategy class delivered end-to-end in production (funding rate arbitrage, basis trading, statistical arbitrage, market-neutral, etc.); proficient with backtesting frameworks and able to independently conduct strategy validation and attribution analysis.

•

Deep Crypto Market Knowledge: Strong command of crypto derivatives market mechanics including perpetual contract funding rates, delivery futures basis dynamics, stablecoin protocol yield structures (USDE / USD1 / BYUSD etc.), and DeFi protocol return mechanisms. Live trading strategy experience is strongly preferred.

•

Programming & Data Analysis: Proficient in Python for strategy development and data analysis (Pandas / NumPy / backtesting frameworks); experience with exchange API integration; able to work with market tick data, funding rate history, and other quantitative datasets.

•

AI / Agent Integration: Hands-on experience building LLM applications or AI Agents; able to encapsulate strategy logic as agent-callable tools and construct automated strategy pipelines from signal analysis through decision-making to execution.

•

Business Acumen & Product Thinking: Able to identify actionable strategy opportunities from a user-value perspective and translate complex quantitative strategies into understandable, actionable product experiences; capable of independently driving strategy concepts from 0 to 1.

Nice to Have

•

Live trading experience with cross-exchange arbitrage (funding rate, cross-exchange spread, basis arbitrage) or on-chain DeFi strategies.

•

Familiarity with on-chain analytics tools (Dune / Nansen / Glassnode) for mining strategy signals from on-chain indicators.

•

Experience developing and operating automated trading systems (quant trading bots, grid strategies, DCA systems, etc.).

•

Understanding of AI-driven signal generation, with practical experience combining market sentiment and quantitative models.

About the role
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on strategic and operational leader to head the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) globally across every jurisdiction where Crypto.com operates. This role owns the end-to-end global financial crime transaction monitoring and investigation lifecycle, functioning as an integrated process chain spanning strategy, policy and procedure design, transaction monitoring rules design and management, transaction monitoring technology, Level 1 quality and SLA governance, Level 2 complex investigations, risk mitigation decisions, and SAR/STR filings across sanctions, AML/CFT, fraud, and complex fiat/crypto typologies.
You will set the global strategy, policies, and implementation procedures; continuously adapt the program to evolving financial crime risks; and assess Crypto.com’s overall transactional financial crime risk posture. Combining deep financial crime expertise with rigorous operational and process discipline, you will directly lead the global rules design, transaction monitoring, investigations, and SARs teams across North America, EMEA, and APAC, while exercising functional oversight over Level 1 alert operations by setting their procedures, monitoring their SLAs, and governing their output quality. You will own our transaction monitoring platforms, maintain real-time operational dashboards, and remain directly involved in complex casework, data analysis, and written work product. Additionally, the role includes interfacing with regulators during examinations and supporting law enforcement and financial intelligence unit engagements. Reporting to the SVP, Compliance in the US, you will partner closely with regional compliance teams, Operations, Data, and Product leadership to keep Crypto.com’s defenses ahead of emerging threats.


Key Responsibilities
Global FIU Strategy & Operating Model

• Define and own the multi-year global FIU strategy, target operating model, and investigative standards, aligned to the firm’s licensing footprint, product roadmap, and regulatory risk appetite.

• Manage the full transactional financial crime process chain, from rule design and alert generation through triage, escalation, investigation, risk mitigation, and SAR/STR reporting, ensuring global consistency with appropriate local tailoring.

• Continuously assess Crypto.com’s overall financial crime posture from a transactional risk perspective, proactively adapting rules, workflows, and controls to evolving money laundering, sanctions evasion, fraud, and terrorist financing typologies.

• Chair the global transaction monitoring Committee; arbitrate cross-regional conflicts on investigative approach, thresholds, and escalation to senior management.

• Own the global FIU budget, headcount plan, vendor strategy (blockchain analytics, case management, data providers), and capacity forecasting across regions.

Transaction Monitoring Tooling, Rules Design & Operational Governance

• Own the firm’s global transaction monitoring tools, blockchain analytics platforms, and case management systems, partnering with Engineering, Data Science, and Product to design, tune, validate, and optimize rule sets and detection logic.

• Exercise functional oversight of Level 1 alert operations, setting their standard operating procedures (SOPs), defining escalation criteria, monitoring SLA posture, and governing disposition quality.

• Establish, track, and enforce strict operational SLAs across all tiers of alert review, investigation, and regulatory filing; ensure executive and operational dashboards are accurate, real-time, and actively used to manage throughput, backlog, and risk.

• Drive continuous improvement in alert efficiency and investigative automation, integrating blockchain analytics directly into workflows and participating in testing and validation.

Investigations, SAR/STR Oversight & Regulatory Interface

• Own end-to-end oversight of complex Level 2 / escalated investigations and global SAR/STR filing quality; set the standard for investigative rigor, narrative quality, and evidentiary support across jurisdictions (FinCEN, FINTRAC, NCA, MAS, AUSTRAC, FIU.net and equivalents).

• Personally lead and conduct the firm’s most sensitive and high-profile investigations — sanctions evasion, terrorist financing, large-scale fraud, market abuse, and nation-state / DPRK-linked activity — and brief the CCO, executive leadership, and board as required.

• Oversee and directly contribute to the firm’s blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring investigative capability using blockchain analytics tools, including typology development, detection logic feedback loops, and darknet/ransomware/mixing/unhosted-wallet coverage.

• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing global transaction monitoring, investigations, and SARs organization across North America, EMEA, and APAC while maintaining direct, hands-on involvement in case reviews, data analysis, and operational execution.

• Support license applications, regulatory examinations, and industry working groups with authoritative investigative evidence and program documentation.

• Represent Crypto.com externally with regulators, external partners,, industry working groups, Egmont Group engagements, and support license applications and examinations

Qualifications
Required

• 12+ years in financial crime compliance, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles running multi-jurisdiction investigations or FIU functions at a regulated financial institution, fintech, or crypto platform.

• Demonstrated ability to combine senior leadership with hands-on execution. This role requires direct contribution to delivery in addition to team management and delegation.

• Deep, hands-on expertise in AML/CFT and sanctions investigations, including direct ownership of SAR/STR filing programs across at least two of the US, EU/UK, and APAC regimes.

• Demonstrated command of blockchain analytics and virtual-asset typologies (darknet markets, ransomware, pig-butchering scams, unhosted wallets, mixers, chain-hopping, OTC brokers).

• Track record of direct engagement with regulators, law enforcement, and financial intelligence units on financial crime matters, examinations, and complex casework.

• Strong operational and analytical judgment: able to structure ambiguous problems, manipulate data, and synthesize board- and regulator-grade reporting.

• Excellent written and verbal communication; able to translate complex crypto and financial crime issues for technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.

Preferred

• Professional certifications such as CAMS, CFE, CFCS, or specialized blockchain compliance certifications (e.g., CCAS, CRC).

• Prior experience as a Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO), BSA Officer, or deputy FIU head at a crypto exchange, payments firm, or global bank.

• Familiarity with enterprise case management, GRC, and transaction monitoring platforms, and with data/analytics tooling used to drive investigative automation.

What success looks like over the first 12 months 
• A unified global FIU operating model in place; defined investigation standards, escalation paths, and QA framework adopted consistently across regions.

• SAR/STR filing quality demonstrably improved: measurable uplift in QA scores, regulator feedback, and reduction in late or remediated filings.

• Regulator and law-enforcement engagement running as a coordinated, global motion; no region operating in isolation on sensitive matters.

• FIU talent bench strengthened: regional Head of FIU structure in place, critical single-point-of-failure risks mitigated, and training/upskilling program live for investigators.

We're looking for a Compliance Officer to work with the Head of Compliance in the day-to-day operation of the local compliance framework. The role will be responsible for assigned compliance activities and may hold an FSRA Approved Person position, subject to the applicable FSRA approval requirements.

The Compliance Officer is responsible for assigned interactions and coordination with regulators, law enforcement and other competent bodies and authorities, and advises staff and senior management on relevant regulatory and internal compliance policy matters.

Are you the right fit for eToro?

Are you a customer and detailed oriented compliance, AML and/or financial crime professional? Are you agile and able to adapt quickly to changes? Do you have good communication skills? Are you keen to learn, can work independently and collaborate across different teams, functions and multiple jurisdictions? Are you a solution-oriented and driven individual? Do you have sound analytical skills? Then you may be the right fit for eToro.

What will you be doing?

As the Compliance Officer, you will work with the Head of Compliance and be responsible for:

• Executing assigned elements of the local compliance strategy and framework, and contributing to the development of local compliance team members as directed by the Head of Compliance

• Carrying out assigned elements of the compliance monitoring plan, including monitoring, surveillance and subsequent reviews.

• Providing advice to staff and senior management on regulatory, policy and procedural issues and their application

• Handling assigned client enquiries, requests for information and client complaints

• Handing Phase 3 Complaints and regulatory referrals

• Conducting compliance impact assessments, risk assessments and gap assessments as appropriate

• Putting in place, updating and maintaining compliance registers

• Identifying, logging and escalating compliance issues, policy and regulatory breaches, and assisting with their resolution

• Reviewing and updating compliance policies and procedures, in line with regulatory changes

• Preparing and coordinating the timely completion and filing of assigned regulatory and AML reports with the regulator

• Preparing compliance management information for the Head of Compliance, SEO, Board and Group Senior Management, and providing input on the regulatory implications of future business strategies

• Staying up to date with regulatory developments both locally and internationally, with particular focus on FSRA policy updates, published guidance from the various UAE regulators and international best practice with potential impact on the business, and escalating relevant developments

• Review, assess and approve new or amended products or services as part of Product governance

• Review, assess and approve marketing, promotional or other iniatives for relevant entity.

• Partnering with the company's MLRO on the review and implementation of AML/CTF policies and the implementation of financial crime compliance monitoring program, and assurance tasks

• Remaining familiar with all AML processes and systems to ensure seamless coverage when cover is required

• Developing and maintaining a positive and constructive relationship with the regulators and responding promptly to any request for information made by the FSRA or any other competent authorities of the UAE

• Complete assigned tasks in relation to the company’s virtual asset regulatory and company obligations

• Lead and/or support the Company with regulatory related projects, or be part of Company’s project team to provide regulatory and compliance inputs in relation to new projects for the business

• Delivering and coordinating compliance training across the business

• Promoting a culture of compliance among all team members and business processes

• Using AI tools to automate, improve efficiency and make more effective compliance processes and tasks

Requirements

• At least 5 years of relevant compliance experience in financial services, including substantial experience with ADGM/FSRA-regulated firms or another UAE/local financial services regulator; experience in a deputy or second-in-command compliance role is preferred

• Experience building and maintaining working relationships with regulators, with direct experience working with the FSRA and/or other ADGM or local UAE regulators required

• Able to advise the Board, senior management and Group colleagues on complex regulatory issues

• Experienced in successfully managing multiple projects and competing priorities at the same time

• Able to work to short timelines in a fast-paced environment

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Eligible to hold, or obtain approval for, an FSRA Approved Person / Authorized Individual function, where required for the position

At eToro, AI is transforming how we build, work, and decide, and our hiring now reflects this. We aim to be an AI-first organization, encouraging thoughtful AI use. Our recruitment uses AI tools, such as interview notetakers, to improve accuracy, consistency, and the candidate experience, supporting fair, consistent assessments grounded in human judgment, experience, and motivation. We want candidates who are comfortable with AI, who explore how they use AI tools, and who understand its opportunities and limitations. For us, being AI-first means augmenting human judgment, combining expertise and creativity with technology to do our best work and grow faster. Ultimately, we're hiring for human insight enhanced by AI.

Our Hiring Philosophy:

At etoro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an AI-first organisation where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully.

That starts with how we hire. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements.

We also want candidates to be comfortable working with AI. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to etoro’s continued AI build-out.

For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for: human insight, supercharged by AI.

About The Opportunity

The Account team owns how every OKX user first gets in and keeps getting in safely. That covers registration, login and authentication, session and device management, account recovery, account security, sub-accounts and institutional accounts, and the full account lifecycle. We build the identity and access foundation that every other product depends on. That foundation has to scale to millions of users across regions and be resilient against constant attack, while still feeling easy to use. Our goal is a platform where strong security and a smooth user experience support each other rather than compete. For accounts, "mostly secure" isn't secure. Every control we build has to be consistent in how it's enforced, complete in what it covers, and explainable when it acts.

What You'll Be Doing

•

Formulate, select and develop technical designs across the account domain. That includes registration and onboarding, login and multi-factor authentication, passwordless login, third-party and single sign-on, session and device management, account recovery, sub-account and institutional account structures, and account lifecycle controls such as freezing, closure and data retention.

•

Build AI/ML-powered features such as account-takeover detection, suspicious-login detection, automated attack and bot defense, risk-based authentication, smarter recovery flows, and support-assist tools for account issues.

•

Organize and coordinate resources, lead research and development, troubleshoot problems, and ensure quality and on-time delivery. This includes integrating AI models into login, risk and recovery workflows.

•

Facilitate cross-team communication and promote efficient teamwork through code quality control and collaboration. This includes partnering with Security, Risk, Data Science, Compliance and Customer Support to bring models into production on reliable, auditable infrastructure.

•

Define where AI-driven judgment is appropriate and where fixed rules are mandatory. For example, a risk score can trigger an extra verification step, but the final access decision and its record have to stay rule-based. Design that boundary cleanly so models help without weakening security guarantees.

•

Take on team tasks and develop technical talent, with a focus on building AI engineering best practices across the team. That means AI-assisted development workflows, reusable prompt patterns, quality evaluation, and human review of AI-generated work in security-critical areas.

What We Look For In You

•

A security-first systems mindset. You naturally design for reliability, safe retries, consistent state, abuse prevention and complete audit trails. You know that in account security, missing an attack means a hijacked account and lost funds, while blocking a real user means lost trust, and you design with both in mind. Prior experience with identity, authentication, access management, anti-fraud or account security is a strong plus. Hands-on experience handling a real account-takeover incident or large-scale attack is an even stronger plus.

•

Solid knowledge of modern authentication and authorization standards, and their common pitfalls.

•

Daily, fluent use of modern AI coding tools. You can describe the specific workflows you run, the failure modes you've hit, and the guardrails you've built around AI-generated code, especially in security-sensitive code. AI fluency is required, not nice-to-have.

•

Production experience integrating AI/ML models into backend services. That includes model serving, real-time signal and data pipelines, low-latency inference on critical user paths, safe fallback when models fail, and processes for monitoring and rolling back models.

•

Hands-on experience with at least one LLM application pattern: knowledge retrieval for support and internal lookup, multi-step AI assistants for support or risk analysts, or LLM-based classification or extraction shipped to production.

•

Discipline around AI output. You don't ship AI features without proper evaluation, accuracy and abuse testing, regression checks, and human review for high-stakes actions such as account recovery or unfreezing. You have an opinion on when to use a large general-purpose model, a smaller specialized model or a simple rule, and you can defend that choice to Security and Audit.

•

A good grasp of software engineering basics and distributed systems principles, including consistency, reliability and data integrity, plus high availability and low latency for high-traffic, user-facing services.

•

Clear logic, quick thinking and good communication, including the ability to write clearly for non-engineers such as product, support, security and audit.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a seasoned engineer to build and improve the ML and data infrastructure behind our risk and fraud prevention systems. You will work hands-on to move models from experimentation into reliable production services, improve model execution performance, and develop data pipelines that support training, evaluation, and real-time decisions. You will take ownership of your work, identify improvements proactively, and deliver with limited guidance

What You’ll Be Doing

• Improve model inference latency, throughput, resource utilization, and cost. Profile the prediction path—from feature retrieval and preprocessing to model execution—and implement measurable improvements while preserving model quality.

• Build and maintain infrastructure for model packaging, versioning, deployment, serving, monitoring, and rollback across cloud platforms and regions.

• Develop and optimize offline data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, and warehouse or lakehouse technologies. Address data modeling, partitioning, joins, shuffles, skew, incremental processing, and cost.

• Work on offline and online feature pipelines, supporting point-in-time correctness, consistent feature definitions, freshness, lineage, and reproducible backfills.

• Build and maintain reliable feature services and data integrations for risk models and decision systems.

• Take ownership of projects and operational issues, communicate progress and tradeoffs, and collaborate with ML, data engineering, cloud infrastructure, security, and product teams.

• Contribute to technical discussions, share knowledge, and help teammates through code reviews and collaboration.

What We Look For In You

• Experience building and operating distributed systems, ML infrastructure, or data platforms, with ownership of meaningful production components.

• Hands-on experience improving production model performance, such as latency, throughput, resource utilization, or cost.

• Strong experience with Databricks and Spark, or comparable offline data platforms, including execution plans, distributed query optimization, storage layouts, data correctness, and workload cost management.

• Experience with the model lifecycle, including training and serving integration, validation, deployment, observability, and rollback.

• Strong Python and SQL skills, plus proficiency in at least one backend or systems language such as Java, Scala, Go, or C++.

• Ability to work independently through loosely defined problems, make sound implementation decisions, and deliver maintainable systems with limited guidance.

Nice to Haves

•

SageMaker, Alibaba Cloud PAI/EAS, or comparable ML platforms.

•

Inference optimization using tools such as ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, or Triton.

•

Delta Lake, MLflow, feature stores, Kafka, Flink, and low-latency data stores.

•

Fraud detection or financial risk systems.

•

Fluency in Mandarin

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

•

L&D programs for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

•

Wellness and meal allowances

•

Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

•

More that we love to tell you along the process!

OKX Statement:

OKX is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, and non-job related physical or mental disability, or protected veteran status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

The salary range for this position is $178,888 to $268,333

The salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. In addition to the salary, a performance bonus and long-term incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, as well as a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Applicants should apply via OKX internal or external careers site.

Company Description
In the fast-growing economies of the world, there's a new generation of ambitious younger people eager to gain financial independence and we’re here to make this potential a reality by empowering them with the Freedom to Succeed.
We empower them with guidance, tools, and easy market access so they can trade and invest with confidence. We aim to make our clients their own wealth manager: empowered to create investment strategies and make investment decisions effortlessly, in their own time, on their own terms, in their own way.
Founded in 1998 to offer online trading for retail clients, the Exinity Group is now over 25 years old and has provided leveraged trading to over 2 million customers through our global power brands, including FXTM and Nemo, giving them access to equity, commodity and FX markets across the Middle East, Asia, and Africa.
Exinity is an energetic and diverse company with central offices in the UAE, Cyprus and the UK, plus a number of smaller hubs globally. We’re always looking for talented individuals to join us. ‘Freedom to Succeed’ is not just a promise we make to our clients and partners, but to our people too. We’ll help you develop a range of skills, take on early responsibility, and enjoy a rewarding and fulfilling career with a fast-growing, dynamic company.

Job Description
We are looking for a data-driven and hands-on Paid Social Media Specialist to join our Acquisition Marketing team.
In this role, you will be responsible for planning, launching, managing, and optimizing paid social campaigns across major platforms including Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, and other relevant social channels. You will work closely with creative, analytics, product, and Commercial Marketing teams to drive customer acquisition, improve campaign efficiency, and scale growth across multiple markets.
This is a highly execution-focused role, ideal for someone with a strong performance marketing mindset and at least 2 years of hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns.
What You'll Do
•
Plan, execute, and optimize paid social campaigns across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Snapchat, and other emerging channels.
•
Manage campaign setup, budget allocation, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and performance monitoring.
•
Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve CPA, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates, and overall marketing efficiency.
•
Conduct audience testing, creative testing, and landing page optimization to maximize campaign results.
•
Collaborate with designers, content creators, and product marketers to develop high-performing ad creatives and messaging.
•
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and platform updates to identify new growth opportunities.
•
Generate regular performance reports and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
•
Work closely with analytics and CRM teams to ensure accurate tracking, attribution, and measurement.
•
Support regional acquisition initiatives and contribute to broader growth marketing projects.

Qualifications
Must Have
•
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field.
•
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience managing paid social campaigns and budgets, including proven experience with Meta Ads Manager and at least one additional platform (TikTok, LinkedIn, X, Snapchat, etc.).
•
Deep understanding of paid social advertising and digital marketing funnels, with strong awareness of the latest platform trends, ad formats, algorithm changes, and best practices.
•
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze user behavior across the funnel using Excel, Google Sheets, GA4, or similar tools, and turn insights into actions that improve performance against business KPIs.
•
Strong audience strategy skills, including identifying, building, and scaling target audiences (e.g., custom audiences, lookalikes, interest-based, and broad targeting).
•
Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities in a fast-paced environment, with strong attention to detail and excellent communication skills in English.
•
Reading and writing proficiency in both Traditional and Simplified Chinese running campaigns in both languages
Nice to Have
•
Experience in the FX/online trading, fintech, financial services, or gaming industries.
•
Familiarity with attribution tools such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, or similar platforms.
•
Working knowledge of SQL, BI tools, or marketing automation platforms.
•
Experience running multi-region or international campaigns.
•
Basic understanding of AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, or Gemini for marketing productivity and campaign analysis.
•
Hands-on experience integrating AI into daily campaign optimization workflows, such as performance analysis, creative testing, and reporting automation.

Job Description
Reporting to the Team Lead /Senior– Customer Service.
We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Thai-speaking Customer Service Representative to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for delivering exceptional support to our Thai, English & other native speaking clients (using google translate), resolving inquiries efficiently, employing a value-based relationship approach such as upselling & cross-selling and ensuring a positive customer experience. You will work in a team comprising culturally diverse professionals with different skill sets who support each other in delivering impactful results.
Key Responsibilities:
• Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and chat in Thai, English & other native speaking clients (using google translate).
• Provide accurate information regarding products, services, and policies
• Resolve customer issues promptly and professionally
• Maintain detailed records of customer interactions in CRM systems
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction
• Identify and escalate priority issues when necessary
• Handle of Back-office queries
• Support clients with technical and troubleshooting issues
• Deal with complaints of a varying nature promptly and effectively
• Meet set performance targets including response time, resolution rate, and customer satisfaction.
• Upsell and cross sell to clients by adding value-added services to improve client retention, acquisition & loyalty.

Qualifications
• Fluency in Thai and English (spoken and written)
• Previous experience in customer service or a similar role and knowledge of financial market will be considered an advantage.
• Strong communication, soft-selling and interpersonal skills
• Ability to work efficiently under pressure
• Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
• Familiarity with CRM systems and support tools is a plus
• Problem-solving mindset and attention to detail
• Knowledge of any other languages is an advantage

Additional Information
Exinity is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partner status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability or age.
